title: Claude features for everyday work quiz

questions.question: Where should a reusable office writing rule go in a practice Project?

answers.feedback: The Project name is not a substitute for instructions.
Correct. Project instructions supply reusable guidance.

answers.text: In a filename Claude never reads.
answers.feedback: A filename is not a reliable place for the writing rule.

questions.question: Which feature is appropriate for an editable checklist beside your chat?

answers.feedback: Correct. An Artifact is separate output you can revise.
The privacy toggle controls model improvement.
Billing does not hold the checklist output.

questions.question: Which file-reading habits are sound? Select all that apply.

answers.text: Compare the summary with the original file.
answers.feedback: Correct. The source remains the evidence.

answers.text: Assume every embedded image was understood.
answers.feedback: Non-PDF text extraction may miss embedded images; inspect important figures yourself.
Correct. Conditions can change the meaning of a summary.

answers.text: Use a small invented practice file.
answers.feedback: Correct. A small invented file suits the exercise.

questions.question: Match each feature with its main purpose in this course.
questions.feedback: Projects hold reusable context; files supply source material; Artifacts hold separate output.

answers.matchText: Related work with reusable instructions and references
answers.feedback: Use Project instructions and knowledge for repeat work.

answers.matchText: Source material to read and check
answers.feedback: Trace the answer back to the attached source.

answers.matchText: Separate output beside a conversation that you can revise
answers.feedback: Review the output before you reuse or share it.

questions.question: Artifacts are unavailable in your approved account. What can you do for the checklist exercise?

answers.text: Ask for a chat draft and review it in your own notes.
answers.feedback: Correct. The fallback still lets you practise drafting and review.

answers.text: Upload private employee files to another account.
answers.feedback: Private data must stay within approved processes.
